name: @askturret/mcp-adapter-test
description: MCP adapter conformance kit - run the shared test bank against any framework adapter

askturret.versioning: This package carries its OWN semver (see KIT_VERSION), scoped to conformance results: it moves when the categories change or an existing one gets stricter, not when @askturret/mcp releases. A result is only meaningful alongside the kit version that produced it.
askturret.publishing: PRIVATE for now, like every other workspace in this repo. Publishing to npm needs a release-policy decision about which workspaces go public — this package depends on @askturret/mcp-adapter-conformance, which would have to go public too, and that pulls in its own dependency chain. Flagged in #54 rather than decided here.
